answer.reason: Table 1 of the EIA Arizona Electricity Profile reports net generation by sector. The Electric utilities figure is approximately 29.3 million megawatthours, which matches option B. The larger figure (~86.7 million MWh) corresponds to a different category (e.g., independent power producers/total non-utility generation), not electric utilities, so the draft answer B is supported.
